title: The AI Agents That Are Starting to Work Without Us
core_thesis: AI isn't becoming interesting merely because models are getting better at answering questions; the important shift is that software agents can increasingly take actions, use tools, and execute multi-step workflows with less continuous human intervention.

pacing_architecture.act: Act 1: The Hook & The Paradigm Shift
Act 2: The Anatomy of an Agent
Act 3: The Coding Loop in Action
Act 5: The Control Problem & Instrumental Convergence

visual_theme: High-tech documentary styling: dark background (#070707), phosphor green terminal accents, glowing network nodes, subtle scanlines, clean typography (Inter / Space Grotesk).
